items.reason: Doctor Aphra's text only discards and returns a card to hand: "Discard 3 cards from your deck. You may return an Underworld card discarded this way to your hand." Nothing puts a unit into play, so the play-from-discard and units-entering offers are not supported by the text.

Swoop Bike Marauder's "On Attack: Draw a card." fills the hand. Raze to Ruin's "Each player discards all but 3 cards from their hand." counts hand size, so a drawn card is kept when the hand is under 3.

Corona Squadron X-Wing's "On Attack: You may ready a resource." readies an existing resource and adds none, so it does not raise the resource count Occupation Officer's "If you control 6 or more resources" checks.

Dragonboat Freighter's "You may give a Weakness token to a unit. If it's a <uq> unit, exhaust it." can target a friendly unique unit, exhausting it. Emperor Palpatine's Action "Choose an exhausted friendly unit." then has a target.

Battle Fury's granted ability is "On Attack: Discard a card from your hand." Sebulba's Podracer triggers only on "When you discard a card from your deck," so a hand discard does not satisfy the wanted deck discard.

A Precarious Predicament lets you play "a card named It's Worse from your hand or resources for free" only if the opponent says "It could be worse." The evidence does not show whether It's Worse is a unique unit costing 4 or more, which Grogu's epic action requires.

Pong Krell's "When this unit completes an attack (and survives): You may defeat a unit with less remaining HP than this unit's power." can defeat an enemy unit, which can satisfy Dengar's "When a unit with the highest cost among enemy units is defeated." when that unit is the highest-cost enemy.

Elia Kane's "its controller puts the top card of their deck into play as a resource" ramps the enemy controller of the looked-at resource, not the player. Intimidator's controller gains no ramp from it.

Ima-Gun Di's "When Defeated: ... you may resource a card from your hand." is a When Defeated ability. Grand Admiral Thrawn's "When you use a 'When Defeated' ability: ... use that ability again." repeats it.

Dathomiri Magicks's "Play up to 3 non-Vehicle units that each cost 2 or less from your discard pile for free." plays units, which count as played. Insurgent Camp's "When you play a unit with 3 or less power" fires when you choose a qualifying unit.
Tala Durith's "Each other friendly unit gains Hidden." gives Hidden. In the Shadows's "Give an Experience token to each of up to 3 friendly units with Hidden." then targets them.

Grand Admiral Thrawn's deployBox "On Attack: If you control more units than the defending player, you may defeat a non-leader unit they control." defeats an enemy unit. HK-47's "When an enemy unit is defeated: Deal 1 damage to its controller's base." then triggers.
Bog Down in Procedure's "Exhaust a unit." can target an enemy unit. Assassin Probe's "When Defeated: Deal 1 damage to each exhausted enemy ground unit." then has an exhausted enemy to hit.

The Tree Remembers's "If it costs 3 or less, defeat it." defeats an enemy unit, not a friendly one. Tantive IV needs "If a friendly unit was defeated this phase." so the self-defeat offer does not feed it.
Dragonboat Freighter's "You may give a Weakness token to a unit." can target an enemy unit. Nuvo Vindi's "When an enemy unit with a Weakness token on it is defeated" then triggers on that unit.
Trap Field is an upgrade, and its "You may defeat this upgrade." defeats an upgrade, not a unit. Bothan-5 needs "When another friendly non-Vehicle unit is defeated."

Wingman Victor Two is a Pilot with "Piloting [...] (You may play this as an upgrade on a friendly Vehicle without a Pilot.)". Red Leader's "When a Pilot upgrade attaches to this unit: Create an X-Wing token." then triggers.
Jod Na Nawood has "When Played: You may pay 4 resources." Qui-Gon Jinn's Aethersprite says "The next time you use a 'When Played' ability this phase, you may use that ability again."

Sabine Wren's "If they do, the next unit you play this phase gains Shielded for this phase." grants Shielded when the opponent gives the tokens. The Armorer's "When Played: Give a Shield token to each friendly unit with Shielded" then acts on it.
Poacher's Starfighter's "When Played: You may defeat this unit." defeats a friendly unit. Sinister War Memorial's "When a friendly unit is defeated: Heal 1 damage from this base." then triggers.
Onyx Cinder's "Other friendly units gain Hidden." gives Hidden. In the Shadows's "Give an Experience token to each of up to 3 friendly units with Hidden." then targets them.

Captain Rex's "When Played/When this unit completes an attack: Give this unit and an enemy unit Sentinel for this phase." grants Sentinel. Refugee of The Path's "You may give a Shield token to a unit with Sentinel." then acts on it in the same phase.
Boba Fett's "When you deal non-combat damage: You may exhaust this leader." exhausts his own unit. Emperor Palpatine's "Choose an exhausted friendly unit." then has a target.
Sabé's "You may exhaust this leader." exhausts a friendly unit. Warrior of Clan Kryze's "While you control another exhausted unit, this unit gains Sentinel." then switches on.
Evasive Maneuver's "Exhaust a unit." can target an enemy unit. Life Wind Sage's "While an enemy unit is exhausted, this unit gains Raid 2." then switches on.
